integrity: Proof and reproducible numerical diagnostics are included; diagnostic discretization does not establish the infinite theorem, whose proof is analytic. No external or independent scientific validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Metric equilateral star with one absorbing terminal, all other terminal points reflecting, Kirchhoff transport at center, instantaneous Poisson resetting to the center. No claim for unequal arms or noninstantaneous resetting, or for a thermodynamic transition. Numerical limiting constants are approximate; exact characterizations are analytic. Historical precedence from unindexed work is not excluded.
title: Topology-dependent benefit of hub resetting in equilateral Brownian stars
